knobs.name: caseT0
knobs.what: s: film time at which the stack-city clock starts (CASE t0); the module's local time is t - caseT0

knobs.name: caseT1
knobs.what: s: film time at which the stack-city clock ends (CASE t1); beats below are converted to fractions of caseT1 - caseT0

knobs.name: arrive0
knobs.what: s: the first person boards (boxes start dropping into the three pooled columns)

knobs.name: arrive1
knobs.what: s: the last person has boarded; must be <= count.at 24.0 so 2,201 is landed before any ratio

knobs.name: arrW
knobs.what: fraction of the CASE clock one box takes to fall and grow into its berth (larger = softer arrival)

knobs.name: drop
knobs.what: world units a box falls from as it arrives (0 = boxes appear in place)

knobs.name: lit0
knobs.what: s: survivors start to light, bottom-up in every column

knobs.name: lit1
knobs.what: s: every survivor is lit (the LIVED row of the ledger lands)

knobs.name: poolPins
knobs.what: s: the pooled pins appear with their counts (N OF M)

knobs.name: ratioDelay
knobs.what: s: a pin's % waits this long after its count (floor 1.5: counts before ratios)

knobs.name: poolOut
knobs.what: s: the pooled pins fade before the re-berthing starts

knobs.name: move0
knobs.what: s: the boxes leave the pooled columns for their class berths

knobs.name: move1
knobs.what: s: the last box is in its class berth

knobs.name: stagger
knobs.what: 0-1: how spread out in time the boxes leave (0 = all at once; each box keeps its own path)

knobs.name: lift
knobs.what: world units: height of the arc each box makes between its two berths

knobs.name: orderMix
knobs.what: 0 = seeded order, 1 = class order (the berths fill one class after another)

knobs.name: berth0
knobs.what: s: the class berths start to show as outlines on the deck (the empty crew-children berth among them)

knobs.name: berth1
knobs.what: s: the berth outlines are fully drawn

knobs.name: berthOp
knobs.what: 0-1: opacity of the berth outlines

knobs.name: tag0
knobs.what: s: the two followed people (a third-class child, a first-class man) take the accent and a riding pin

knobs.name: tag1
knobs.what: s: the followed people return to their group colour; pins off

knobs.name: turn0
knobs.what: s: the camera starts its turn (keep equal to move0: the turn and the re-berthing are one gesture)

knobs.name: turn1
knobs.what: s: the camera arrives at the berth view

knobs.name: az0
knobs.what: degrees: azimuth of the pooled view (0 = straight on the three columns)

knobs.name: az1
knobs.what: degrees: azimuth of the berth view (90 = square on to the class row)

knobs.name: elev0
knobs.what: degrees: elevation of the pooled view (higher shows more roofs)

knobs.name: elev1
knobs.what: degrees: elevation of the berth view (lower flattens the row, higher separates labels)

knobs.name: orbitAmp
knobs.what: degrees: amplitude of the calm orbit sway, the whole film (0 = still camera)

knobs.name: orbitPeriod
knobs.what: s: period of the calm orbit sway (longer = slower)

knobs.name: fit0
knobs.what: ortho extent multiplier in the pooled view (larger = further away)

knobs.name: fit1
knobs.what: ortho extent multiplier in the berth view (larger = further away)

knobs.name: fitReveal
knobs.what: multiplier on the extent during the reveal (below 1 = a slow push in)

knobs.name: lookY
knobs.what: 0-1 of the city height the camera looks at (larger moves the city down the frame)

knobs.name: boxSize
knobs.what: world units: edge of one person's box

knobs.name: boxGap
knobs.what: world units: seam between boxes

knobs.name: slabLayers
knobs.what: boxes high a class berth is (rate form: every berth the same height, so lit height = share who lived)

knobs.name: slabDepth
knobs.what: boxes deep a class berth is (along the view axis of the berth view)

knobs.name: slabGap
knobs.what: world units: aisle between classes

knobs.name: pairGap
knobs.what: world units: gap between the women, children and men berths of one class

knobs.name: groupGap
knobs.what: world units: gap between the three pooled columns

knobs.name: poolLayers
knobs.what: boxes high a pooled column is (rate form: width = how many, lit height = share who lived)

knobs.name: poolDepth
knobs.what: boxes deep a pooled column is

knobs.name: deckPad
knobs.what: world units: deck margin around the berths

knobs.name: planks
knobs.what: number of plank seams across the deck (0 = plain deck)

knobs.name: dim
knobs.what: 0-1: how far a person who did not live is mixed toward the deck (larger = darker)

knobs.name: maskDim
knobs.what: 0-1: how far everyone outside the counted pair dims during the reveal

knobs.name: ambient
knobs.what: fill light on every face (display-linear multiplier)

knobs.name: keyLight
knobs.what: key light from above-left (display-linear multiplier)

knobs.name: rimLight
knobs.what: rim light from behind-right (display-linear multiplier)

knobs.name: deckMix
knobs.what: 0-1: deck colour from ground (0) to panel (1)

knobs.name: plankMix
knobs.what: 0-1: plank seam colour from ground toward muted

knobs.name: berthMix
knobs.what: 0-1: berth outline colour from ground toward accent

knobs.name: hold
knobs.what: frames a label must be pushed before it hides (gl-labels hysteresis)

knobs.name: leader
knobs.what: sheet units: leader length of a slab pin

knobs.name: maxShown
knobs.what: label budget per frame (manager: 12)

knobs.name: pinLift
knobs.what: world units: a pin's anchor above its berth's roof

knobs.name: pinSize
knobs.what: sheet units: slab pin type (secondary floor 14)

knobs.name: poolPinSize
knobs.what: sheet units: pooled pin type (result floor 28)

knobs.name: calloutSize
knobs.what: sheet units: callout type (result)

knobs.name: calloutLeader
knobs.what: sheet units: callout leader length

knobs.name: revealSize
knobs.what: sheet units: the two reveal results

knobs.name: per10Size
knobs.what: sheet units: the natural-frequency line in the reveal

knobs.name: plate
knobs.what: 0-1: opacity of the dark plate behind a pin's text

knobs.name: chromeDim
knobs.what: opacity of the slab pins the callout does not name

knobs.name: dispAdv
knobs.what: em: average advance of the display face, for label boxes

knobs.name: slabPins
knobs.what: s: the eleven slab pins enter with their counts

knobs.name: call0
knobs.what: s: callout on the first- and second-class children

knobs.name: call1
knobs.what: s: callout hard cuts to the third-class children

knobs.name: call2
knobs.what: s: callout hard cuts to the first-class men

knobs.name: callEnd
knobs.what: s: the callout ends before the reveal

knobs.name: crewAt
knobs.what: s: the slab pins return and the callout names the crew men

knobs.name: reveal0
knobs.what: s: everyone outside the counted pair starts to dim

knobs.name: reveal1
knobs.what: s: the dim is complete

knobs.name: revealPins
knobs.what: s: the two results appear (labels after post, flat)

knobs.name: per10At
knobs.what: s: the natural-frequency line appears

knobs.name: revealEnd0
knobs.what: s: the reveal starts to lift

knobs.name: revealEnd1
knobs.what: s: the reveal has lifted (crew beat)

knobs.name: postLevel
knobs.what: gl-post level: exec = tone map only; manager = bloom, vignette (and dof)

knobs.name: bloomGain
knobs.what: bloom strength on the counted pair (0.04-0.12 typical; 0 = off)

knobs.name: bloom0
knobs.what: s: bloom starts to rise (after the dim, so only the counted pair glows)

knobs.name: bloom1
knobs.what: s: bloom at full gain

knobs.name: bloom2
knobs.what: s: bloom starts to fall

knobs.name: bloom3
knobs.what: s: bloom off

knobs.name: glowGain
knobs.what: emission of the counted pair's lit boxes in the reveal (> 1 glows)

knobs.name: vignetteGain
knobs.what: corner darkening in the reveal window

knobs.name: dofGain
knobs.what: depth of field (0 = off: ortho scene, and it costs ~0.5 s/frame)

knobs.name: exposure
knobs.what: pre-tonemap exposure, the whole film

knobs.name: monday0
knobs.what: s: the city starts to dim for Monday

knobs.name: monday1
knobs.what: s: the city is at Monday exposure

knobs.name: mondayExposure
knobs.what: exposure of the city under the Monday question

knobs.name: mondayGlow
knobs.what: emission of the counted pair under the Monday question (a faint glow, no bloom)

knobs.name: hookAt
knobs.what: s: the rule starts to type

knobs.name: hookCps
knobs.what: characters per second the rule types

knobs.name: hookOut
knobs.what: s: the rule fades before the first person boards

knobs.name: hookSize
knobs.what: sheet units: the rule (display face)

knobs.name: ledgerSize
knobs.what: sheet units: ledger numbers (must-read)

knobs.name: ledgerDim
knobs.what: opacity of the ledger once the re-berthing starts

knobs.name: ledgerOut
knobs.what: s: the ledger leaves (before the slab pins, which need its corner)

knobs.name: mondaySize
knobs.what: sheet units: the Monday question
